project.name: reliability
project.description: Pure-arithmetic reliability estimators (BinomialReliability: unbiased pass@k and pass^k), shared by core/quality (in-app eval runs, the promotion gate, and the standalone CI golden-dataset harness in its eval package - merged from the former core/eval module) so the maths exists exactly once. True leaf: no dependency on any other core module and no Spring. It keeps the package com.agenticai.core.quality.stats on purpose - the class used to live in core/quality and every existing import stays valid (a split package across jars is fine on the plain classpath this project uses; there is no JPMS).
